subject: Intimate customer briefing — venue, transport, NDA
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@the-lighthouse.com>; caroline.kim@maplehealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Intimate customer briefing — venue, transport, NDA

Hi Sophie & Caroline,

Thanks again for making space for a small, in-person briefing the week of Nov 9. We want to host ~14 guests (mix of product + customer execs) for an evening conversation off-site. Key items from our side:

- Target date: Wednesday, Nov 11 (flex Nov 10/12 as backup)
- Time: 6:00–8:30pm (brief remarks at 6:30)
- Dietary: we'll collect restrictions but expect 3–4 vegetarian, 1 gluten-free
- Security/compliance: attendees require a simple NDA; we can provide our standard form

Sophie — could you confirm availability and a ballpark on private-room fee + tasting menu options? Also please confirm if you can handle a short, signed NDA on arrival or if you need us to send a pre-signed copy.

Caroline — I want to confirm Maple Health's guest list will be ~6 attendees. I can share names by next Tuesday.

I've looped Marissa (events lead) and Connor (ops) for logistics and parking/transport coordination.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Head, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
[attachment: NDA_Redwood_Template_2026.docx]

> Sophie — could you confirm availability and a ballpark on private-room fee + tasting menu options? Also please confirm if you can handle a short, signed NDA on arrival or if you need us to send a pre-signed copy.

I added Evelyn from Legal to review the NDA template. Connor — please build a one-page guest spreadsheet (name, title, company, dietary, phone) and share by next Tue. I can handle RSVPs and name badges.

Logistics checklist (short):
- Guest spreadsheet (Connor)
- NDA handling (Evelyn)
- Parking/ride-share block (Connor)
- Menu selection and final headcount (Marissa)

If Sophie prefers we can do a tasting the week prior; budget permitting.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Intimate customer briefing — venue, transport, NDA

Hi Mina/Marissa,

Thanks — Nov 11 is currently available; we can also hold Nov 10 or 12 as alternates. Private dining room fee is $1,200 (includes dedicated server). Tasting menu options attached (see menu_tasting_sheet.pdf) — chef can do a 4-course prix fixe at $95/person or a 6-course at $145/person.

We can accept a pre-signed NDA via email prior to the event or collect signatures at check-in. For speed, upload the NDA here and we'll countersign: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/contract-1147

Also attaching our standard venue contract; happy to take your edits.

Best,
Sophie Grant
Venue & Events Manager
The Lighthouse

Hi all,

Reviewed the NDA template Mina attached. A couple of small redlines:
1) Limit scope clause — change from "all product roadmaps" to "discussion materials and demo artifacts shared during the event"
2) Data retention clause — add 30-day retention for any attendee sign-in lists

Sophie — if you can countersign once we upload the updated doc (we'll push via DocuSign), that should be enough. Marissa/Connor — please do not share attendee contact info publicly; we will provide a limited sign-in clipboard at check-in and an access-controlled PDF for venue use only.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: booking@the-lighthouse.com <booking@the-lighthouse.com>

Hi Mina/Marissa,

Thanks — we've added your provisional booking for Nov 11 (private room) and received the DocuSign request. Contract countersigned and deposit invoice attached (invoice_1147.pdf). Chef confirms 4-course at $95/person by default; we can upgrade to 6-course pending final headcount. We've also reserved 6 street parking permits (+2 accessible spots) and arranged a preferred ride-share pickup point at the corner of 5th & Pine.

Please send final guest list and dietary restrictions by Nov 3. We will have a clipboard for on-site NDA signatures as a backup, but countersigned DocuSign is preferred.

Attachments: invoice_1147.pdf

Thanks,
Booking Team
The Lighthouse
